lines.en: My silver scales scatter the moonlight.

lines.zh: 我走起来会反出一线光。
lines.en: A thin line of light follows me.
I walk the steps of the ruin.
My steps are light and my scales chime.
I walk toward the damp.

lines.zh: 我从倒塌的石柱间穿过去。
lines.en: I pass between fallen columns.
My wingtips brush the ground.

lines.zh: 我走到开阔的地方站住。
lines.en: I walk into the open and stop.
My tail sways behind me.
I come toward you, unhurried.
I stand, my silver scales faintly bright.
There's no other colour on me.
I fold my wings neatly.
I look down at my own shadow.
The wind makes my scales sound.
I turn my head toward the light.
My claws rest on the stone.
I say nothing.

lines.zh: 我身上的银色在暗处很清楚。
lines.en: My silver shows clearly in the dark.
I open my wings a little more.

lines.zh: 我把一条前腿搭在台阶上。
lines.en: I rest a foreleg on the step.
I turn to look at the door on the other side.
My silver scales shine; I make no sound.

lines.zh: 你看见我这一身银鳞了。
lines.en: You've seen my silver scales.
I raise my head and the shine sweeps over you.
I neither hide nor move.
My head rises above your shoulder.
I draw my claws in slowly.
You're looking at the markings on me.
My head tilts just slightly.
If you back away, I won't follow.
These scales look fine, don't they.

lines.zh: 我在看你的手会不会动。
lines.en: I'm watching to see if your hand moves.
I've remembered how you look.
I recoil, silver scales standing.

lines.zh: 这一下在我的银鳞上开口。
lines.en: That opens a seam in my silver.

lines.zh: 我低头看了看自己的鳞。
lines.en: I look down at my own scales.
I retreat a stretch.
My shine dims.
I don't let the pain out.
I brace on a column.
Blood shows starkly on silver.
Even so I'm standing steady.
That has no shine to it.
Silver scales, out of an ancient egg.
I don't eat; I only look.
Keep it; it suits you.
It isn't as bright as my scales.

lines.zh: 你手里那点东西，可诱不动一条龙。
lines.en: Whatever you're holding won't lure a dragon.

lines.zh: 想用食物哄我？先过我这关。
lines.en: Trying to coax me with food? Get past my temper first.

lines.zh: 再靠近一步，我就当你来挑战我。
lines.en: One more step and I'll take it as a challenge.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，银鳞响了一声。
lines.en: You hit me and my silver scales ring.
I fall back about half a foot.

lines.zh: 这一下在我的鳞上留了印。
lines.en: That leaves a mark on my scales.
I turn my flank and you don't hit again.
I lower my head to settle my scales.
I stand still, not angry.
Light spreads off me in a ring.
I draw my tail in.
I walk back to where I was.
That bump cost me not one scale.
Her silver is brighter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们站在两根柱子之间。
lines.en: We stand between two columns.
She touches her head to my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们的鳞碰在一起，响了。
lines.en: Our scales meet and ring.
We both look into the dark.
Her wings are narrower than mine.
We walk the steps side by side.

lines.zh: 她把尾巴绕到我的上面。
lines.en: She lays her tail over mine.

lines.zh: 月光落在我们两个身上。
lines.en: Moonlight falls on us both.
She goes in first.
I pinch it up in a claw.
It throws back the light in my hand.
The silver glare makes me squint.
The quality's not bad.

lines.zh: 鳞片在龙爪里转了个面。
lines.en: The scale turns over in my claws.
I set it back on the stone slab.
With my snout, I push it half an inch forward.
It slips through my claws.
I don't look at it again.
I heard it — over there.

lines.zh: 我把头转过去，鳞光亮了。
lines.en: I turn my head and my scales brighten.
I come down off the steps.
This one doesn't seem hostile.
I close in bit by bit.
My claws are out.
My wings snap open.
It's still standing where it was.
I press my body lower still.
This ground is mine to patrol.
I raise my head a little.
I watch it without moving.
I follow along the colonnade.
My shine moves along the wall.
It turned into the side hall.
I go round by the other end.
I cross without a single sound.
It stands there listening.
I go still as well.
It doesn't look this way again.

lines.zh: 碎裂的石子在我脚下响。
lines.en: Broken gravel sounds under my feet.
It turns around suddenly.
I'm right in front of it.
It raises one hand.
I bring my claws down.

lines.zh: 爪子刮过石面，火星四溅。
lines.en: My claws rake the stone, throwing sparks.
My teeth close on its shoulder.
It backs off; there's blood on my scales.
I swing my head and knock it aside.
It blocks my claws.
I leap and come down on it.
Its weapon skids off my scales.
The second bite goes in harder.
I throw it against the wall.
It steadies against a column.

lines.zh: 我身上的银鳞，凉得像冰水。
lines.en: My silver scales feel like ice water.
My shadow covers it.
Silver scales light up in the dark.

lines.zh: 我慢慢从台阶上站起来。
lines.en: I rise slowly on the steps.
I spread my wings and shake off the dust.

lines.zh: 这里的石头上还有刻痕。
lines.en: The stone here still bears carvings.
I raise my head; my shine passes the columns.
I try two strides.
My claws find good footing.
My head turns slightly that way.
The air here is old.
I step down off the stairs.
Silver light falls on the ground.
The chill around me spreads.
Silver scales glare in the sun.

lines.zh: 火燎过银鳞，我甩了甩翅膀。
lines.en: Fire rakes my silver; I shake my wings.
I land hard on the stone steps.
Water rises and I strain upward.
The blast slams me into a column.

lines.zh: 一支尖东西扎穿我翅膀。
lines.en: Something sharp goes through my wing.

lines.zh: 那道光在我鳞上闪了一下。
lines.en: The light flashes across my scales.

lines.zh: 太久没进食，我的腿发虚。
lines.en: Too long unfed, my legs weaken.
Lightning hits my silver and it all lights up.

lines.zh: 脚下什么都没有，我一直落。
lines.en: Nothing beneath me; I keep falling.
